pages.name: Suspicious Double Bass
pages.description: Bleating comes from behind the double bass again. The instrument sways slightly, although there is neither a draft nor any musicians in the room.

options.description: Play a gentle scale on the grand piano
Look behind the double bass at once

pages.name: Musical Goat
pages.description: On the third note, a small goat cautiously emerges from behind the double bass. It listens to the rest of the scale, nods contentedly, and resolutely follows you. It seems you now have a very musical milk supplier.

scenePatch.description: The space behind the double bass is now empty. Only a few hoofprints and a forgotten sheet of music remain on the floor.

pages.name: Awkward Introduction
pages.description: You abruptly peer behind the double bass and come nose to nose with a goat. The goat bleats indignantly, leaps over a stool, and disappears into the corridor. A minute later, it is behind the double bass again, but now regards you with much greater suspicion.

pages.name: Rehearsal Continues
pages.description: You decide not to interfere. After a while, another quiet bleat comes from behind the double bass, matching the pitch of the old grand piano surprisingly well.
